question: David Ryan buys fresh 52-week-high breakouts, not stale ones -- expect LOWER days_since_52wh (fresher high) to show a BETTER (higher) stop-R than a stale one on burst events
plain: David Ryan's rule: buy a stock making a brand-new 52-week high, not one that hit its high weeks ago and has since drifted. This checks if a fresher high beats a stale one.
